concerns.text: FR-002 and SC-001 require the 'Synthetic SpatialClaw Proxy' data generation. Task T006 ('Implement code/data/generator.py') is marked as incomplete ([ ]). Without this task, the dataset `data/raw/synthetic_spatialclaw_v1.json` cannot be produced, blocking all downstream agent execution and metric collection.

FR-007 and SC-001 require re-running the 3D baseline agent to generate a paired dataset. Task T023b ('Execute code/agents/baseline_3d.py... dynamically generate the paired dataset') is marked as incomplete ([ ]). The required artifact `data/baseline_spatialclaw.csv` is missing, making the core statistical comparison impossible.

SC-004 (GitHub Actions budget constraint) requires a power analysis to determine sample size N. Task T035b ('Implement Power Analysis & Budget Validation') is marked as incomplete ([ ]). The experiment scope is undefined, risking violation of the 6-hour runtime budget.

FR-003 requires recording wall-clock time excluding blocked library attempts. Task T026 ('Implement logic to exclude blocked 3D library initialization time') is marked as incomplete ([ ]). The latency metric will be inaccurate without this logic.

FR-001 and US-1 require logging blocked operations and seed values. Task T011 ('Setup logging infrastructure') is marked as incomplete ([ ]). Verification of stochasticity control and kernel blocking behavior is impossible without logs.
FR-006 requires a sensitivity analysis CSV with specific columns. Tasks T031, T031b, and T032 are all marked as incomplete ([ ]). The sensitivity analysis cannot be performed or reported.

Constitution Principle I (Reproducibility) and Principle III (Data Hygiene) require pinned environments and validated data schemas. Tasks T001 (project structure), T003 (linting), and T010 (schema files) are marked as incomplete ([ ]), contradicting these constitutional requirements.

FR-008 requires executing at least 5 independent runs per task instance with derived seeds. While T017 is marked complete, the task description relies on T022b (Collector Integration) which is marked complete, but the orchestration loop logic in `code/main.py` to actually drive the N>=5 loop and log run IDs is not explicitly detailed as a separate, verified task in the incomplete list, creating ambiguity on whether the loop logic itself is fully implemented or just the seed utility.
